lines: Par ye sab shuru hua aaj raat…
Kinnaur ki raat, 2:45 baje, bus pahadiyon se guzarti.
Driver bola, “Raat ka safar, dhyan se.”
Aarav maa ki tasveer dekh raha, bus ki khamoshi mein.
Phone par ajeeb number aaya: ‘Nisha Daak’.
Driver ne zor se kaha, “Call na kare,” stranger sir hila.
Bansuri ki dhun, pine ki khushboo, wheel ghoomta.
Photo ki dhundhli tasveer mein uska baap dikha, awaaz: “Main hi tera baap hoon.”
Driver ne aankh milai, “Ab safe ho gaye,” hawa thandi.
Bus dhire dhire neeche girti, landslide se bacha liya.
Us raat ka darr, ab sach hai.
